### A Tale of Two Sons
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/tale-two-sons
Passage: Matthew 21:28-32
Points:
- Jesus rebukes religious leaders by demonstrating that genuine obedience requires action rather than mere lip service.
- God graciously pardons and receives those who initially rebel but later repent and do His will.
- Despised outcasts who acknowledged their spiritual poverty entered the kingdom before self-righteous authorities who rejected the truth.
- Discernment of the obedient son convicts the leaders of their own unacknowledged guilt and resistance to God.
- Believers must not presume upon their own goodness but maintain ongoing repentance and reliance on God's mercy.
